cohort: A 24-year-old primigravid woman at 28 weeks of gestation with drug-refractory atrial tachycardia and heart failure, and her newborn.
finding: Attempted radiofrequency ablation during pregnancy for drug-refractory atrial tachycardia resulted in maternal hypotension and fetal heart rate reduction, leading to an emergency cesarean section, after which a successful ablation post-delivery improved maternal cardiac function and the newborn was discharged in good condition.
mod_finding: An emergency cesarean section was performed due to maternal hypotension and persistent fetal heart rate reduction encountered during an attempted radiofrequency ablation procedure while the mother was pregnant.
birth_weight: Not explicitly stated, but implied to be less than 2500g as the newborn was hospitalized until reaching this weight.
gest_age: 28 weeks (at presentation and likely at birth)
